text: Good afternoon and good morning everyone. Welcome to BizLink's Third Quarter Earnings Call hosted by UBS. I am Allie Cheng covering the industrial sector. Before we start, I'd like to ask for your support in the Institutional Investor survey. Now let me hand over the call to Mike.

Thank you, Allie, and thanks to UBS. Welcome to BizLink's third quarter 2026 earnings conference call. Our financial results and presentation materials are available on our Investor Relations website. Today's call will begin with Charles, followed by Florian and Felix, after which we will open for Q&A.

Thank you, Mike, and good afternoon everyone. Before reviewing our third quarter financial performance, I want to put it into the context of BizLink's continuing development and the increasingly sophisticated business we are building. Our third quarter results reflect continued progress in expanding our business and strengthening operating performance.

Gross margin expanded while disciplined expense management brought our OPEX ratio to a record low level. Together, this improvement lifted operating margin to a new high. As we expand our revenue base, we are generating greater efficiency across manufacturing, engineering, and administrative functions.

Turning to our business, HPC continues to benefit from sustained investment in AI infrastructure. For the first nine months of 2026, HPC power connectivity grew 97% year-on-year while data connectivity grew 49% year-on-year, contributing to overall HPC growth of 77% year-on-year.

Our capital equipment business has also delivered exceptional performance. Since the 2023 base year, BizLink's SPE business has substantially outgrown the broader semiconductor equipment market. This outperformance continued during the first nine months of 2026 when SPE revenue grew 48% year-on-year.

On a first nine months basis, Factory Automation sales are up 18% year-on-year, Healthcare is up 7%, Energy is up 17%, and EV is up 21%. Looking back at BizLink's development, we have doubled our monthly revenue in progressively less time even as our scale has grown.

Interplex contributed only 7 days of revenue to our third quarter consolidated results, while October represents its first full month of consolidation. Its initial operating momentum has exceeded our expectations at the time of acquisition with October revenue approaching $67 million USD.

As we approach 2027, our business is entering its next stage of development with a larger revenue base, broader capabilities, and stronger operating leverage. Our objective is productive scale that supports sustainable earnings and cash generation.

Thank you, Charles. Across our business, we see a common development: customers increasingly expect suppliers to do more than deliver individual components. They require engineering support, manufacturing readiness, and supply chain flexibility.

Thank you, Florian. We increasingly view HPC as a long-duration investment cycle rather than a single technology generation. Computing platforms are advancing rapidly, creating demanding requirements for power delivery, data connectivity, and cooling.

During 2026, we demonstrated optical shuffle solutions at OFC, CPO switch solutions at Computex, and a 12.8T XPO transceiver at OCP. These illustrate our growing capabilities in precision optical assembly and integration.

Our demonstrations at Computex and OCP also highlighted how we are preparing for liquid-cooled AI rack environments, featuring high-current power distribution, cold plates, manifolds, and leak detection capabilities.

Interplex adds another important set of capabilities. Its experience in precision mechanical engineering, enclosures, and subsystem integration complements our existing electrical and optical connectivity capabilities.
Thank you Charles, Florian, and Felix. Now let us begin the Q&A session. Please type your questions into the chat box.

Regarding Interplex, October revenue contributed $67 million USD in its first full consolidated month. The momentum actually exceeded our expectations at the time of acquisition and shows very promising operational synergy.

On optics and CPO, we demonstrated our optical shuffle and CPO switch solutions. We are advancing next-generation optical scale-up interconnects, including micro-VCSEL based technologies to support demanding connectivity requirements.
Power demand continues to escalate with higher compute density. We offer comprehensive power solutions spanning busbars, power whips, busways, and rack-level power distribution architecture.

Looking into 2027, key growth drivers remain HPC AI power and data connectivity, along with semiconductor production equipment (SPE), supported by gradual recovery in industrial and automotive segments.
This concludes our Q&A session. A replay will be available on our IR website within 24 hours. Thank you very much for joining today's call.
